# IPC commands (167)

Every `#[tauri::command]` of the backend, with its frontend callers. "Runs on": `main thread` = plain `fn` command (blocks the UI thread: keep it light, see AGENTS.md §7); `async pool` = `#[tauri::command(async)]` or `async fn`. Injected parameters (`State`, `AppHandle`, `Window`) are omitted. A reference is any string literal equal to the command name (direct `invoke` or a task wrapper such as the `command:` field of a task); computed names are not detected.
